lines.en: label beachsevenchika1:
scene chikayumishower1
And so I take you somewhere else without the use of teleportation, just secret narrator powers.
lines.zh: 于是，我把你带到另一个地方——不用传送，只靠旁白的秘密力量。

lines.en: It’s somewhere far detached from the [[mind]set you just stood in, but not so far detached from where you’re meant to be right now according to my outline.
lines.zh: 它远离你刚刚所处的那种[[心]态，但按我的大纲，又没太远离你此刻该在的地方。

lines.en: But ignoring my broken tripod and the roaring sounds of water crashing down onto both stone and the reddened flesh of an unpictured girl, the mood here is better. Relaxed.
lines.zh: 但抛开我那副坏掉的三脚架，以及水砸在石头上、砸在某个没有立绘的女孩泛红烧红的皮肉上的轰鸣，这里的气氛更好。放松。

lines.en: The sun has begun its descent and, with it, madness too disembarks in preparation for the evening’s promised melancholy.
lines.zh: 太阳开始下沉，疯狂也随之离船上岸，为今夜许诺好的忧郁做准备。

lines.en: A door slides open, revealing she who carries such cholera — nude once more thanks to the author’s perversions and their apparently infinite desire to see her exposed breasts.
lines.zh: 一扇门滑开，露出了携带着这份愁绪的她——又一次赤身裸体，这得归功于作者的变态癖好，以及他们想看她裸露乳房的、显然无穷无尽的渴望。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower2
And next, the music.
lines.zh: 接下来，是音乐。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower3
It isn’t the “normal” song for a situation like this. Especially when she who canonically sings it is currently in the backseat of a limousine right now.
lines.zh: 对这种场景来说，这首歌并不「常规」。尤其是按官方设定唱这首歌的那位，此刻正坐在一辆豪车的后座上。

lines.en: But it helps set the stage. And it’s only one step detached from a song the naked girl in front of us would memorize on early-morning walks to school.
lines.zh: 但它有助于铺陈。而且它离我们面前这个裸着的女孩会在清晨上学路上背熟的那首歌，只差一步。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower4
That tinny, overmodulated sound you only get from old or cheap headphones would do nothing to distract her from the words she’d hear but never heed.
lines.zh: 那种只有老旧或便宜耳机才有的、发闷又过调的声音，丝毫不能让她分心——她听得见那些歌词，却从不放在心上。

lines.en: {size=-2}Then sooner rather than later, she’d be plucking them from her ears and fixing her skirt before sitting down beside the girl she just laid her eyes on — the second-most impermanent recipient of all of her “good mornings.”{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}然后没过多久，她就会摘下耳机、理好裙子，坐到她刚刚看上的那个女孩身边——那个收下她所有「早上好」的、第二不长久的人。{/size}

lines.en: : Yumi?...
lines.zh: : Yumi？……

lines.en: scene chikayumishower5
: Oh, good. Glad it’s you and not somebody else. Saves me an assault charge.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。幸好是你不是别人。省得我再吃一桩伤人罪。

lines.en: : Since when do you shower before it’s dark out?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候开始天没黑就洗澡了？

lines.en: : Since when do {i}you{/i} shower after the sun starts setting?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}什么时候开始太阳下山了才洗澡的？

lines.en: scene chikayumishower6
: I figured this was the best time to come here without bumping into anybody else. I take it you’re...in the same boat?
lines.zh: : 我觉得这个时间来最不容易碰到别人。所以你也是……一样的情况？

lines.en: : Pretty much. Never got a chance to take one last night, so I figured I’d get it out of the way now before dinner.
lines.zh: : 差不多。昨晚没机会洗，所以我想赶在晚饭前先解决掉。

lines.en: : Should I wait until you’re done then?...
lines.zh: : 那我等你洗完？……

lines.en: scene chikayumishower5
: Huh?
: Because, like...I don’t know. You don’t really like me anymore and you wanted to be alone. So I’m kind of intruding.
lines.zh: : 因为，就是……我也不知道。你已经不怎么喜欢我了，而你想一个人待着。所以我有点像是在打扰。

lines.en: : I can wait. It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 我可以等。没事的。

lines.en: : Chika, did you somehow manage to forget who cast who aside in the middle of your year-long psychotic break? Cause I sure as fuck ain’t the one who stopping liking you.
lines.zh: : Chika，你是怎么做到忘记在你那一整年的精神失常里，到底是谁把谁甩开的？因为我他妈绝对不是那个不再喜欢你的人。

lines.en: : Right. I get that. But, if I were you, I’d probably think I’m pretty fucking selfish and stupid and not want to be naked beside me anymore.
lines.zh: : 对，我明白。但换作是我，大概会觉得自己又自私又蠢，再也不想跟我裸着待在一起了。

lines.en: : Weird to say this, but you’ve seen me naked more than literally anybody else I’ve ever known. I really don’t give a shit.
lines.zh: : 这么说挺怪的，可你是这辈子见过我裸体最多的人，比任何人都多。我真的一点都不在乎。

lines.en: : It’s...okay if join you then?
lines.zh: : 那我……可以跟你一起吗？

lines.en: scene chikayumishower7
: Yeah, sure. It’s fuckin’ {i}creepier{/i} with you hanging out in the background like that, so just hurry up and sit down already.
lines.zh: : 行，来吧。你在后面那么晃着才他妈{i}瘆人{/i}，赶紧滚过来坐下。

lines.en: scene black
scene chikayumishower8
: Thank you. For both letting me be naked with you and also not hating me despite you having every right to do that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你。既谢谢你让我跟你一起裸着，也谢谢你没有恨我——尽管你完全有这个权利。

lines.en: : Just glad you seem fuckin’ normal today. Been a while.
lines.zh: : 只是很高兴你今天看起来他妈的正常。好久没这样了。

lines.en: : I’m getting there. How’s your mom?
lines.zh: : 我在好转。你妈怎么样？

lines.en: scene chikayumishower9
: Oh. Uhh...she’s alright, I guess.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……她还行吧，大概。

lines.en: : Tsubasa’s taking care of her, right?
lines.zh: : 是 Tsubasa 在照顾她，对吧？

lines.en: : That’s one way to put it. Not sure if it’s just cause she’s payin’ for her whole treatment or what, but that lady’s got Yuki on a fuckin’ leash it seems.
lines.zh: : 也可以这么说。不知道是不是因为她掏钱付了整个疗程还是怎样，反正那个女人看起来把 Yuki 用他妈的狗链拴着。

lines.en: : You’re still calling her Yuki even after everything that’s happened?
lines.zh: : 发生了这么多事，你还叫她 Yuki？

lines.en: : Just because she’s dying don’t mean I’m gonna forgive her for choosin’ drugs over me when I was a kid. Think she’ll {i}always{/i} just be Yuki to me. Callin’ her “Mom” or whatever just feels weird.
lines.zh: : 她快死了，不代表我要原谅她小时候选了毒品而不是我。我想她对我来说{i}永远{/i}只是 Yuki。叫她「妈」什么的，感觉太怪了。

lines.en: : Fair enough. I’m glad to hear she’s okay, though. Even if I am obligated to hate her as your friend. If...we’re still even-
lines.zh: : 说得也是。不过听到她没事我还是很高兴——哪怕作为你的朋友我有义务恨她。如果……我们还算是——

lines.en: scene chikayumishower10
: Yes, you sappy piece of shit. We are still {i}friends.{/i} Now, stop being weird about it already.
lines.zh: : 是啦，你这个多愁善感的混蛋。我们还是{i}朋友{/i}。行了，别再为这事别扭了。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower11
: Noted...Though, it seems like I have some work to do if I’m going to reclaim my spot as your {i}best{/i} friend from Noriko, who has apparently seized it.
lines.zh: : 记住了……不过看来，要想从 Noriko 手里夺回我「{i}最好的{/i}朋友」的位置，我还得下点功夫——她显然已经抢占了。

lines.en: : Oh, fuck off. I ain’t gonna rank the two of you. Probably not fair to Noriko if anything since you’re way less annoying than she is when you aren’t trying to kill me.
lines.zh: : 哦，滚你的。我才不会给你们两个排名。真要说不公平，那也是对 Noriko 不公平——毕竟你不琢磨着杀我的时候，可比她烦人得少多了。

lines.en: : Chinami’s been asking about you, you know.
lines.zh: : Chinami 一直在问起你，你知道吗。

lines.en: : Why? She texts me all the fuckin’ time about when I’m going to come around again.
lines.zh: : 为什么？她他妈天天给我发短信，问我什么时候再去。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower12
: Oh, right. I wonder why she asks me at all then?
lines.zh: : 哦，对。那我倒想知道她为什么还要来问我。

lines.en: : Some kinda subliminal messaging or some shit, maybe. Trying to get you to reach out to me, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概是什么潜意识暗示之类的狗屁吧。我猜是想让你主动联系我。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower13
: Maybe...
lines.zh: : 也许吧……

lines.en: : And I’m sorry I haven’t. I’ve been {i}thinking{/i} about you, though. It’s just, like...I kind of needed some time away from...basically everyone in order to get my head on straight again.
lines.zh: : 还有，我很抱歉一直没联系你。不过我一直在{i}想{/i}你。只是，就是……我需要离开……基本上所有人一段时间，才能把脑子重新理顺。

lines.en: : Yeah, you made that pretty apparent during {i}Christmalloween.{/i} Guessing that’s why you’re hiding in the showers at like 4:00 PM too? Afraid of bumping into {i}Rin{/i} or something?
lines.zh: : 是啊，{i}Christmalloween{/i} 那会儿你就表现得挺明显的。所以你才下午四点躲进淋浴间？怕撞见 {i}Rin{/i} 什么的？

lines.en: : Let’s, like...{i}not{/i} talk about Rin, if possible. The less I think about her, the better. And I already spent most of our last meeting bitching about my own life, so it’s your turn now.
lines.zh: : 我们……能不能{i}别{/i}谈 Rin。我越少想起她越好。而且上次见面我大半时间都在抱怨自己的人生，所以这回该轮到你了。

lines.en: : You sure about that? Cause I ain’t got much to bitch about and it sounds like {i}you’ve{/i} got a ton.
lines.zh: : 你确定？我可没什么好抱怨的，倒是{i}你{/i}听起来有一大堆。

lines.en: : Alternatively, we could just, like...not bitch about anything at all and just hang out like old times? I’m sure {i}some{/i} good stuff has happened to us in the last year or so, right?
lines.zh: : 或者，我们可以……什么都不抱怨，就像从前那样单纯地待着？过去这一年左右，我们身上总该发生过{i}一些{/i}好事吧？

lines.en: scene chikayumishower14
: Uh...y...yeah...
: I guess...not {i}everything{/i} has been shitty...
lines.zh: : 我猜……也不是{i}所有事{/i}都那么糟……

lines.en: : {i}Oooooh?...{/i}Now {i}that’s{/i} a rare expression. Do tell...
lines.zh: : {i}哦哦哦？……{/i}{i}这可真是{/i}少见的表情。说来听听……

lines.en: scene black
: A...Actually, I...I’m done showering and I’m gonna go, like...soak in the hot spring now.
lines.zh: : 那……其实，我……我洗完了，我要去……泡温泉了。

lines.en: : Oh, wait! I want to come. I’ll be quick.
lines.zh: : 啊，等等！我也要去。我很快。

lines.en: : A quick shower for you is like thirty fucking minutes, so I’ll just see you when I’m about to get out, I guess.
lines.zh: : 你所谓的「很快」就是他妈三十分钟，那我大概只能在出来的时候见着你了。

lines.en: : No, I can {i}actually{/i} be quick this time! There’s gossip involved!
lines.zh: : 不，这次我{i}真的{/i}可以很快！因为有八卦！

lines.en: : It’s not even gossip! Just fucking...take your time or whatever!
lines.zh: : 那根本不是八卦！就他妈的……你慢慢洗就行了！

lines.en: : Nope! Done now.
lines.zh: : 不！我洗完了。

lines.en: : There’s no way that was enough time! You didn’t even wash your hair.
lines.zh: : 这点时间怎么可能够！你连头发都没洗。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower15
: Well, duh. Washing your hair every day is actually {i}bad{/i} for it. And I’ve definitely told you that before, so don’t pretend this is new information.
lines.zh: : 那当然了。天天洗头其实对头发{i}不好{/i}。我以前肯定跟你说过，别装作这是新消息。

lines.en: : Ain’t bleaching your hair bad for it too? What happened to using your natural color?
lines.zh: : 漂头发不也伤头发吗？你不是说要用自然发色？

lines.en: : A little thing called mania. I’m sure you’ll experience it one day when your emotions finish developing and you decide to shave your head in a fit of rage or something.
lines.zh: : 有个东西叫躁狂。等你的情绪发育完，哪天一怒之下把头剃光之类的，你也会体会到的。

lines.en: : I hope not. Pretty sure shaved heads don’t normally go well with my, uhh...{i}size.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但愿不会。我敢肯定光头跟我的，呃……{i}身材{/i}不太搭。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower16
: Have they gotten bigger? Because I feel like they’ve gotten bigger.
lines.zh: : 它们是不是变大了？我觉得它们变大了。

lines.en: : A little bit, yeah...Don’t fuckin’ stare at ‘em, though. Unless you’re gonna try and get gay with {i}me{/i} next.
lines.zh: : 有一点点吧，嗯……不过别他妈盯着看。除非你接下来打算跟{i}我{/i}搞蕾丝。

lines.en: : Are you saying it’s okay if I {i}do{/i} get gay with you?
lines.zh: : 你是说，我{i}搞蕾丝{/i}也行？

lines.en: : If you don’t mind drowning in a hot spring, yeah.
lines.zh: : 只要你不怕在温泉里被淹死，行啊。

lines.en: : So what was that blush before? What are you not telling me?
lines.zh: : 那你刚才脸红什么？有什么是没告诉我的？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. Really. I’d prefer to, like...keep this to myself. For probably a hundred different reasons.
lines.zh: : 别管了。真的。我更想……把这事藏在自己心里。大概有一百个不同的理由。

lines.en: : Okay. I’m not gonna pry or anything. But know that you {i}can{/i} talk to me if you want to.
lines.zh: : 好。我不会刨根问底的。但你要是想说，{i}随时可以{/i}跟我说。

lines.en: : And even if it’s something about you, like, {i}making out{/i} with Sensei or something, I’m not going to try to kill you again. I’ve more or less come to terms with his...{i}promiscuity{/i} by now.
lines.zh: : 就算是关于你，比如说，跟 Sensei {i}接吻{/i}之类的事，我也不会再想杀你了。我对他的……{i}滥交{/i}，基本上已经想开了。

lines.en: : I...will keep that in mind.
lines.zh: : 我……会记住的。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower17
: You know...it’s kind of weird. I feel like I always wind up in the bath with people on the days I doubt myself the most. I wonder if the universe is trying to tell me something?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……有点奇怪。我觉得我总是在最怀疑自己的日子里，跟别人一起泡澡。我在想，这是不是宇宙在暗示我什么？

lines.en: : What? You mean, like...bathe more?
lines.zh: : 什么？你是说，比如……多洗澡？

lines.en: : No, idiot. Something about, like...calming down and remembering my roots. Taking things easy.
lines.zh: : 不是，笨蛋。是类似于……冷静下来，记起自己的根。把事情放轻松。

lines.en: : You sure that ain’t just you prescribing some sorta meaning to random shit cause you want to hear it? How the fuck is bathing “returning to your roots?”
lines.zh: : 你确定这不是你硬给随机的事赋予意义，因为你想听到那个答案？洗澡他妈的怎么就成「回归本源」了？

lines.en: : Because this is how I grew up.
lines.zh: : 因为我就是这么长大的。

lines.en: : My mom and I {i}always{/i} bathed together before she died. And it wasn’t just great for bonding, but it saved money on water too. It’s how we connected. Like a good luck ritual to start every day.
lines.zh: : 我妈去世前，我们{i}总是{/i}一起洗澡。那不光很有助于增进感情，还省水费。那是我们连接彼此的方式。像每天早上开场的好运仪式。

lines.en: : Ahh, yeah. Guess you and Chinami do that shit too. Can see what you mean now, I guess.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。你和 Chinami 也搞那套。现在我大概懂你意思了。

lines.en: : Maybe it’s some sort of vulnerability thing? Like, completely shedding your armor in front of somebody else makes it easier to come clean and not keep hiding stuff you would be otherwise.
lines.zh: : 也许这是一种「展露脆弱」的事？比如，在别人面前彻底卸下盔甲，会更容易坦白，不再藏着那些本来会藏起来的东西。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower18
: Or maybe you’re just gay as fuck and like being naked with other girls.
lines.zh: : 或者你只是他妈的同性恋得要死，喜欢跟别的女孩裸着待一起。

lines.en: : My mom and Chinami included?
lines.zh: : 连我妈和 Chinami 也算？

lines.en: : You could be into fuckin’ feet for all I know and I’d have no idea. Not really a thing we talk about.
lines.zh: : 说不定你他妈的恋足我都不知道。这种事我们又不怎么聊。

lines.en: : Hey, I am {i}more{/i} than willing to talk about all sorts of sexual stuff with you. {i}You’re{/i} the one who has essentially stitched her vagina shut so you’ll never have to worry about it.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我可是{i}非常{/i}愿意跟你聊各种性方面的事。{i}是你{/i}把自己的阴道基本上缝死了，好让自己永远不用操心这个。

lines.en: : Yet you accused me of sleeping with the man you {i}love{/i} behind your back. Seems like a shitty thing to remove my {i}stitches{/i} for.
lines.zh: : 可你还指控我背着你跟{i}你爱{/i}的男人上床。为了这种事来拆我的{i}线{/i}，好像挺糟的。

lines.en: : That was a different Chika. I’m the good one. I exist again.
lines.zh: : 那是另一个 Chika。我是好的那个。我又存在了。

lines.en: : How can I be so sure?
lines.zh: : 我凭什么这么确定？

lines.en: scene chikayumishower19
: Well...I guess you {i}can’t,{/i} really. Like, {i}I{/i} never thought I’d just lose my mind like that. {i}I{/i} never thought I’d lose sight of what really matters. And yet I did.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想你{i}确实没法确定{/i}。就像{i}我{/i}从没想过自己会那样发疯。{i}我{/i}从没想过会看不见真正重要的东西。可我还是做了。

lines.en: : So I paid the price for it and ruined the second most important relationship in my life.
lines.zh: : 于是我为此付出了代价，毁掉了我人生中第二重要的关系。

lines.en: : You mean you and Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你是说你和 Sensei？

lines.en: scene chikayumishower20
: No, you stupid bitch! I mean {i}you!{/i}
lines.zh: : 不是，你这个蠢货！我是说{i}你{/i}！

lines.en: : Well, is Chinami in fuckin’ {i}third{/i} then? Because there ain’t no way I’m more important to you than Sensei is.
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 他妈的排{i}第三{/i}？因为我不可能比 Sensei 对你更重要。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower21
: You {i}are,{/i} though. I was just so blinded by my entire life unraveling that I lost sight for a moment.
lines.zh: : {i}你就是{/i}更重要。我只是被整个人生崩塌晃瞎了眼，才会有一瞬间看不见。

lines.en: : Sensei ain’t ever been your “entire life,” Chika. You just told yourself he was because you want to live in a fuckin’ fairy tale where everything is good all the time and that just ain’t ever gonna be true.
lines.zh: : Sensei 从来都不是你的「整个人生」，Chika。你只是告诉自己他是，因为你想活在一个一切永远都好的、他妈的童话里——而那永远都不会成真。

lines.en: : I {i}know{/i} that. And this isn’t me trying to avoid responsibility or whatever, but you {i}know{/i} why that happened, right? You know why I broke so easily.
lines.zh: : 我{i}知道{/i}。而且这不是我在推卸责任什么的，可你{i}知道{/i}为什么会那样，对吧？你知道我为什么那么容易崩。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower22
: Course I know. That’s why I don’t hold it against you.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道。所以我才不怪你。

lines.en: : Always knew you were gonna crack one day. That’s why I’ve always tried to warn you about that guy. It’s always people in positions like yours that get this shit the worst.
lines.zh: : 我一直知道你有一天会崩。所以我才一直警告你离那家伙远点。总是像你这种处境的人，被这种事伤得最狠。

lines.en: : {size=-2}You wrap everything up in one person and put all your faith in {i}them{/i} because it makes the burden you’re carryin’ a little less heavy. Then you remember at the end of the day why you were carryin’ shit alone in the first place.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}你把一切都系在一个人身上，把全部信仰交给{i}他{/i}，因为那样你肩上扛的重担会轻一点。然后到了一天结束时，你又会想起自己当初为什么是一个人扛着这些破事。{/size}

lines.en: : There’s a reason I let myself get close to you, Chika. And it’s cause we ain’t really all that different at the end of the day. You just...like to pretend we {i}are{/i} sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我让自己靠近你，是有原因的，Chika。因为说到底我们没那么不一样。只是……你有时候喜欢假装我们{i}不一样{/i}。

lines.en: : Why didn’t you hit me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么没打我？

lines.en: scene chikayumishower23
: Heh?
: Like, you could have literally just slapped some sense into me and you didn’t.
lines.zh: : 就是，你本来可以直接一巴掌把我打醒，可你没有。

lines.en: : You tryin’ to blame all this shit on me not hitting you now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是打算把这一切都赖在我没打你头上？

lines.en: : Of course not. Just, you know, maybe {i}actually{/i} hit me if I wind up losing myself again. I honestly think it could work.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。只是，你懂的，要是我再迷失一次，就{i}真的{/i}打我。我真心觉得那可能管用。

lines.en: : Should I hit you right now then?
lines.zh: : 那我现在就打你？

lines.en: scene chikayumishower24
: Now? But I thought I was cured. I thought I was good again?
lines.zh: : 现在？可我以为我治好了。我以为我又变好了？

lines.en: : Social butterflies don’t form cocoons in the middle of parties, dude. You’re out here avoiding confrontation cause you’re scared of what’ll happen out there when you bump into fuckin’ {i}Rin.{/i}
lines.zh: : 社交蝴蝶可不会在派对正中间结茧，兄弟。你在这儿逃避冲突，是因为你怕出去撞见他妈的 {i}Rin{/i} 时会发生什么。

lines.en: : We agreed to not talk about her. Stop it.
lines.zh: : 我们说好不谈她的。别说了。

lines.en: : You make a choice yet? Which one of them it’s gonna be? Cause that’s what you’re hung up on, yeah?
lines.zh: : 你选好了吗？会是她们中的哪一个？因为你就卡在这上面，对吧？

lines.en: scene chikayumishower25
: I chose Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我选了 Sensei。

lines.en: : Yeah, of fuckin’ course you did.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你他妈的当然会选他。

lines.en: : I know it’s the {i}wrong{/i} choice. And I don’t want this to sound like I’m some sort of martyr or whatever-
lines.zh: : 我知道这是{i}错误{/i}的选择。我也不想让这听起来像我在当什么殉道者——

lines.en: : Good, because I deal with enough of that shit from Noriko.
lines.zh: : 最好别，Noriko 那套我已经受够了。

lines.en: : I just...think it’s what’s better for Rin. And I don’t want to be confusing her when she’s still trying to figure out who {i}she{/i} is.
lines.zh: : 我只是……觉得这对 Rin 更好。我不想让她困惑——她还在弄清楚{i}自己{/i}是谁。

lines.en: : So you think it’s {i}better{/i} for Rin to go fuck some creepy old guy than a girl her age who she’s already had feelings for in the past.
lines.zh: : 所以你觉得，让 Rin 去跟某个猥琐老男人上床，比跟一个和她同龄、她过去就对她有过感情的女孩在一起{i}更好{/i}？

lines.en: : {i}Obviously not.{/i} I just think I shouldn’t be making any choices {i}for{/i} her. Especially when most of those choices were driven by my...uhh...{i}irrational obsession{/i} with her.
lines.zh: : {i}显然不是。{/i}我只是觉得我不该{i}替{/i}她做任何选择。尤其是当那些选择大多是被我对她的……呃……{i}非理性痴迷{/i}驱动的。

lines.en: : You implying there’s some kinda obsession that {i}is{/i} rational?
lines.zh: : 你是在暗示存在某种「{i}理性{/i}」的痴迷？

lines.en: : Well, that’s kinda just what love is as a whole, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 嗯，可这不就是爱本来的样子吗，你不觉得？

lines.en: scene chikayumishower26
: Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 不太觉得，不。

lines.en: : Don’t fucking lie to me, whore. I’m not going to forget we’re only in here because you got all embarrassed and stormed off after I asked you if anything good has happened lately.
lines.zh: : 别他妈跟我撒谎，婊子。我可没忘，我们之所以会在这儿，是因为我问你最近有没有什么好事发生，你就窘得落荒而逃。

lines.en: : Can we not?
lines.zh: : 能不能别提了？

lines.en: : You pressed me about Rin, so it’s only fair I get to press you about this.
lines.zh: : 你逼我谈 Rin，所以我逼你谈这个才公平。

lines.en: : Just ignore it and we can call it even for you almost killing me that one time.
lines.zh: : 就当没这事，我们就扯平了——抵你那次差点杀了我。

lines.en: : When did it happen? {i}What{/i} happened?
lines.zh: : 什么时候发生的？{i}发生什么了{/i}？

lines.en: : Chika-
lines.zh: : Chika——

lines.en: : It’s Sensei, right? For real this time.
lines.zh: : 是 Sensei，对吧？这次是真的。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower27
: It was bound to happen eventually, Yumi. I’ve known you like him even longer than {i}you{/i} have. And I’m...happy for you. Really.
lines.zh: : 早晚会发生，Yumi。我知道你喜欢他的时间，比{i}你自己{/i}知道得还久。而我……为你高兴。真的。

lines.en: : No you fuckin’ ain’t, Chika. You’re as loyal as a fucking dog and I...I...kissed your...whatever the fuck he is.
lines.zh: : 不，你他妈的才不高兴，Chika。你忠诚得像条他妈的狗，而我……我……亲了你的……不管他算你什么。

lines.en: : Do dogs cheat on their owners now? Because {i}I{/i} did.
lines.zh: : 狗现在也会背着主人偷腥了吗？因为{i}我{/i}就干过。

lines.en: : Yeah, to get back at your fuckin’ {i}owner{/i} for spending all of his free time rolling around with other dogs at the local pound. That ain’t your fault.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那是为了报复你那个{i}主人{/i}把他所有空闲时间都花在本地收容所里跟别的狗打滚。那不是你的错。

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter whose {i}fault{/i} anything is. What matters is that it happened. And that it will {i}keep{/i} happening because he just...isn’t happy with one dog.
lines.zh: : {i}是谁的错{/i}根本不重要。重要的是它发生了。而且它会{i}一直{/i}发生，因为他就是……不会满足于只有一条狗。

lines.en: : He won’t be happy with any amount of {i}dogs.{/i} He’s a fucking man-whore.
lines.zh: : {i}狗{/i}再多他也不会满足。他就是个他妈的烂裤裆。

lines.en: : You’re right. He won’t. That’s why he hangs out somewhere they’re all desperate to be adopted. He can get all their hopes and up...make them envision a perfect little home where they get all the attention they need.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。他不会。所以他就待在一个所有人都拼命想被领养的地方。他可以吊起她们所有的期待……让她们幻想一个完美的小家，在那里她们能得到所有需要的关注。

lines.en: : Where their every need is taken care of and they never have to worry about anything. And all it takes is a few minutes of patting our heads and giving us little treats.
lines.zh: : 在那里她们的每个需求都被照顾，永远什么都不用操心。而代价不过是拍拍我们的头、给点小零食的那几分钟。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower28
: Dogs...people...we’re all pretty simple, really. We just want to feel loved and special.
lines.zh: : 狗……人……我们其实都很简单。我们只是想感到被爱、感到特别。

lines.en: : And it doesn’t really matter how much of a lone wolf you are when you’re a pack animal by instinct, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 而当你本能上是群居动物时，你有多独来独往其实并不重要，Yumi。

lines.en: : It’s probably sad watching everyone else at the pound get taken on walks while you sit there in your cage, barking at anyone who walks by.
lines.zh: : 看着收容所里别的狗都被牵出去散步，而你坐在笼子里冲每个路过的人狂吠，大概挺可悲的。

lines.en: : They don’t realize you’re just barking because you’re scared, though. They don’t realize that...you’d make a {i}great{/i} dog if someone just gave you the chance.
lines.zh: : 可他们不明白，你叫只是因为你害怕。他们不明白……只要有人给你一个机会，你会成为一条{i}很棒的{/i}狗。

lines.en: : I’m glad you get to go for a walk now. That you’re getting the chance I got. That everyone got.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴现在轮到你出去散步了。你得到了我得到的那个机会。也是每个人都得到的那个。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower29
: Not sure how much of a fan I am as referring to a bunch of girls as dogs and some fuckin’ weird guy as the only human in this hypothetical.
lines.zh: : 把一群女孩说成狗、又把某个怪大叔说成这个假设里唯一的人类，我不太喜欢。

lines.en: : It’s more about our ages and less about our sex. Like, Miss Watabe would be a human too or something. It isn’t {i}only{/i} Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这更多是关于年龄，而不是性别。比如 Watabe 老师也会是「人类」之类的。{i}不只是{/i} Sensei 一个。

lines.en: : You really aren’t mad at me? Because I’ve felt like shit about this, I’m not gonna lie.
lines.zh: : 你真的不生我的气？因为这事让我难受死了，我不骗你。

lines.en: : You and Noriko are {i}both{/i} wrapped the fuck up in him and I’m just over here, like...not hating him as much as I used to. What gives me the right to do what you guys do?
lines.zh: : 你和 Noriko {i}都{/i}跟他缠得死死的，而我却在这儿……没那么恨他了。我凭什么做你们做过的事？

lines.en: : Since when do you care about your “rights?”
lines.zh: : 你什么时候开始在乎自己的「权利」了？

lines.en: scene chikayumishower30
: Yo. The fuck are you doing?
lines.zh: : 喂。你他妈在干嘛？

lines.en: : {i}My{/i} Yumi never concerns herself with what she is or isn’t allowed to do. She does things anyway. Regardless of the consequences they could bring.
lines.zh: : {i}我的{/i} Yumi 从来不在乎自己被允许做什么、不被允许做什么。她照样去做。不管会带来什么后果。

lines.en: : Cool, yeah. You gotta rub your boobs against me to tell me that, though?
lines.zh: : 行，是啊。可你得把胸蹭在我身上才能说这话？

lines.en: scene chikayumishower31
: Yes, actually. As a matter of fact, I do.
lines.zh: : 对，实际上，没错。

lines.en: : Well, {i}stop.{/i} You know this shit makes me feel weird.
lines.zh: : 行了，{i}停下{/i}。你知道这事让我感觉很怪。

lines.en: : If you feel weird about your best or {i}ex{/i} best friend pressing her boobs against you, how the hell are you going to feel when Sensei has his naked body pressed against yours?
lines.zh: : 如果你的{i}前任{/i}或现任最好的朋友把胸贴在你身上都让你觉得怪，那等 Sensei 把裸体贴在你身上时，你该怎么办？

lines.en: scene chikayumishower32
: Chill, dude! It was just a fuckin’ kiss!
lines.zh: : 冷静点，兄弟！就他妈亲了一下！

lines.en: : Yeah, for {i}now.{/i} But then it’ll be fingering. And handjobs. And before you know it, the two of you are going to be tangled up in the sheets of his bed. Or your bed. Whoever’s bed, really. Probably both.
lines.zh: : 是啊，{i}现在只是{/i}。可接下来就是手指。然后是手活。不知不觉间，你们两个就会在他床上的被子里缠成一团。或者你的床。谁的床都行。大概两张都有。

lines.en: : I...already told him I don’t wanna do that shit! I want to, like...go slow and...everything.
lines.zh: : 我……已经跟他说过我不想做那些事了！我想……慢慢来，还有……一切。

lines.en: : Yeah, good luck with that. And not just because he’s Sensei either. It’s because hormones are evil and being alone together with the person you like will {i}do things{/i} to you. {i}Bad{/i} things. And you will give in to them.
lines.zh: : 行，祝你好运。还不只是因为他是 Sensei。而是荷尔蒙是邪恶的，跟喜欢的人单独待在一起会对你{i}做些什么{/i}。{i}坏事{/i}。而你一定会屈服。

lines.en: : On second thought, I think I preferred it when you {i}did{/i} hate me for potentially doing shit with him! That was way better than this!
lines.zh: : 再想想，我觉得我更喜欢你因为我和他可能做了什么而{i}恨我{/i}的时候！那比现在好多了！

lines.en: scene chikayumishower33
: I love you so much, Yumi. I {i}missed{/i} you so much.
lines.zh: : 我太爱你了，Yumi。我好{i}想{/i}你。

lines.en: : Stop growing up without me. We’re supposed to do that together.
lines.zh: : 别再丢下我一个人长大了。我们说好要一起长大的。

lines.en: : Well, was I supposed to just...fuckin’ {i}wait{/i} all this time? The hell do you want from me?
lines.zh: : 那我该……他妈的一直{i}等{/i}下去吗？你到底想让我怎样？

lines.en: : Just you in general. It’s nothing specific.
lines.zh: : 就想要你这个人而已。没什么具体的要求。

lines.en: : Okay, then sure. Let’s be fuckin’ friends again or whatever. I don’t know how to cook and you do so I’m already benefiting from this.
lines.zh: : 行，那好吧。我们就他妈的重新做朋友什么的。我不会做饭而你会，我已经从这事里受益了。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower34
: Good! Now, tell me more about your {i}kiss.{/i} How’d it happen? {i}Where{/i} did it happen? Who initiated it?
lines.zh: : 好！那现在，多跟我讲讲你的那个{i}吻{/i}。怎么发生的？{i}在哪儿{/i}发生的？谁先主动的？

lines.en: : Think I liked you better when you were strictly into monogamy.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我还是更喜欢你严格奉行一夫一妻制的时候。

lines.en: scene chikayumishower35
: Oh my god! This means I can finally teach you how to suck a dick now! I’ve waited forever for this!
lines.zh: : 天啊！这意味着我终于可以教你怎么口交了！我等这天等了好久！

lines.en: scene noonsky
And so the chapter closes on a friendship once fragmented as two parties pick up the pieces.
lines.zh: 于是，这一章在一度破碎的友谊上落下帷幕，两个人各自拾起碎片。

lines.en: Each one assembles a half of a heart and presses them together, reluctantly as it may be, to form a key that opens a door to a brand new coloring book.
lines.zh: 每人拼出半颗心，把它们按在一起——尽管有些不情愿——合成一把钥匙，打开通往一本全新涂色书的门。

lines.en: Upon realizing they only have one crayon, however, they will need to learn to share if they want to work on completing said book and opening the next door.
lines.zh: 然而，当她们发现她们只有一支蜡笔时，就必须学会分享，才能继续涂完那本书、打开下一扇门。

lines.en: Breaking the crayon in half is impossible, you see. The crayon has bones and will bleed all over the place.
lines.zh: 把蜡笔掰成两半是不可能的，你看。那支蜡笔有骨头，会弄得满地是血。

lines.en: But the bright side is that it changes colors every thirteen minutes and vibrates gently between thumb and forefinger.
lines.zh: 但好消息是，它每十三分钟换一次颜色，还会在拇指和食指之间轻轻震动。

lines.en: All of this means nothing, of course. This passage is but a coloring book as well. One sold on shelves all over the country. And so its guts will always be different, but its cover never changes.
lines.zh: 当然，这一切都毫无意义。这段本身也不过是一本涂色书。一本在全国各地货架上贩卖的涂色书。所以它的内页永远不同，封面却从不改变。

lines.en: Books like this do not have chapters. But you can certainly draw them in.
lines.zh: 这样的书没有章节。但你当然可以自己把它们画上去。
